_doc: Fresh-context audit verdicts (data-fabrication-auditor, Sonnet, 2026-10-09) for East and North-East India + Daman/Diu/Silvassa. Taxi loads ONLY with KEEP/CORRECT. Food: every food figure with a tier was audited, so unaudited food is skipped. A CORRECT food verdict with budget null keeps the standard figure and the old range ratio.

bhubaneswar.note: odishataxi.in (Bhubaneswar address) One Day City Tour by Car Rs 2500 incl driver allowance, toll, parking; Shree Kshetra Travels sedan from 2500.

bodh-gaya.note: bodhgayatravels.com (Bodhgaya address) Etios/Dzire 8 hr/80 km Rs 2250; BodhiGO lists 2500, so 2250 is the low end.

daman.note: mstravelssilvassa.com Daman 80 km/8 hr Dzire Rs 1,600 + 5% GST = 1,680; single Silvassa-based operator, indicative.

daringbadi.note: Patra Travels prints the same Rs 2,000 8h/80km card on Bengaluru, Agra and Ahmedabad pages: a template.

darjeeling.note: darjeeling-tourism.com (Mar 2022) Mixed Point 7h Rs 3,500 small taxi; touradviser.in (Jan 2026) 3,500-4,000; darjeelingtaxi.com 3,000.

deoghar.note: sreetravel.com is a Jamshedpur multi-city template (Ranchi and Jamshedpur show the same card); no Deoghar-based operator rate.

diu.note: MakeMyTrip Diu page timed out; snippet only 'from Rs 3,212', far above other Diu quotes (1,500-2,520).

gopalpur-on-sea.note: Both sources are Berhampur-Gopalpur round-trip packages, not a Gopalpur local day.

guwahati.note: Savaari 'starts at 1575' appears identically on other cities' pages (template floor); Gozo Guwahati is a 4hr/40km package only.

imphal.note: Blog average sourced to Imphal Cabs, a template operator; one-way Loktak fares are not a local day.

kalimpong.note: darjeeling-tourism.com 3,500 (Mar 2022), darjeelingtaxi.com 3,000, sikkimtaxis.com 3,800, others 2,000-3,000; median 3,000; old private-operator quotes, not a union card.
